verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents automations such as custom categorization rules, AI Close agents, and "described once, done automatically" tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations themselves. Reviewing automated output before it is final, and voiding edited manual journal entries, are adjacent features and do not deliver the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
